title: Count the Number of Good Nodes
summary: Tree rooted at node 0. A node is good when all of its child subtrees have the same size. Count good nodes.
examples: Search summary reported outputs 7, 6, 12 for unnamed inputs; no statement inputs were obtained. Examples in the app are illustrative (not from the statement).
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts at most 12 nodes. A leaf counts as good because it has no child sizes that differ.
